tenseicraft.skill.strength_3.desc: +1 Additional permanent melee attack damage (+3 total).

tenseicraft.quest.alice_trial.title: Reaper Trial: Rank D
tenseicraft.quest.alice_trial.desc: Defeat 5 Rank D monsters (Witches, Hoglins, Trident Drowneds).
tenseicraft.quest.novice_hunt.title: First Hunt
tenseicraft.quest.novice_hunt.desc: Defeat 5 monsters of Rank F or higher.
tenseicraft.quest.beast_trapper.title: Camp Supplies
tenseicraft.quest.beast_trapper.desc: Hunt 6 animals to gather vital provisions.
tenseicraft.quest.cave_purge.title: Underground Purge
tenseicraft.quest.cave_purge.desc: Defeat 3 monsters of Rank D or higher in caves.
tenseicraft.quest.arcane_awakening.title: Arcane Awakening
tenseicraft.quest.arcane_awakening.desc: Evolve an accessory by imbuing it with lightning.
tenseicraft.quest.abyssal_slayer.title: Abyssal Slayer
tenseicraft.quest.abyssal_slayer.desc: Defeat 3 monsters of Rank C or higher in Deepslate.
tenseicraft.quest.cultist_hunt.title: Rank A Mission: The Corrupted Reaper
tenseicraft.quest.cultist_hunt.desc: Travel into the Abyss dimension and defeat the Cultist before the Demon race is revived.
tenseicraft.quest.main_01_welcome.title: First Steps Part 1: Welcome to TenseiCraft!
tenseicraft.quest.main_01_welcome.desc: Thank you for giving this mod a chance! My partner and I poured so much love and excitement into creating it, I hope you enjoy it! To advance in the story of this mod, you first need to defeat any enemy — once you do, a surprise awaits! Good luck!
tenseicraft.quest.main_02_ascend.title: First Steps Part 2: Ascend!
tenseicraft.quest.main_02_ascend.desc: I love seeing you progress! From this point on, your real adventure begins — defeat strong creatures and become an elite hero in this world!
tenseicraft.quest.main_02_ascend.objecti: Ascend for the first time (Rank F to E)
tenseicraft.quest.main_03_adventurer.tit: First Steps Part 3: Become an Official Adventurer!
tenseicraft.quest.main_03_adventurer.des: You have broken past your first mortal limit. Find a village with a Guild House, talk to the Guild Master, and register to officially become an adventurer and receive your Guild Card.
item.tenseicraft.escape_scroll.desc: Mystic parchment inscribed with dimensional return coordinates.
tenseicraft.trial.blood_spilled: You have spilled blood for the first time. An unknown presence watches you as night falls...
tenseicraft.trial.title: ✦ THE INTERDIMENSIONAL VOID ✦
tenseicraft.trial.subtitle: An unknown presence observes you...
tenseicraft.trial.dialogue_2: I sense the stench of blood on your hands. You have taken your first step as a warrior, but your flesh is still frail.
tenseicraft.trial.dialogue_3: I bestow upon you the Warrior's Blessing, yet blessings are not gifted... they are seized in combat!
tenseicraft.trial.ares_1: Magnificent! Your martial spirit blazes fiercely.
tenseicraft.trial.ares_2: I am Ares, the God of War. From this day forth, the secrets of physical prowess are revealed to you.
tenseicraft.trial.ares_3: You have obtained your first Physical Skill Point (+1)!
tenseicraft.trial.ares_4: Open your Adventurer Sheet (H key or inventory) and consult the Physical Skill Tree to begin your martial path.
tenseicraft.item.first_sword.name: First Sword
tenseicraft.item.first_sword.lore_1: Relic of the God of War
tenseicraft.item.first_sword.lore_2: Forged in the primordial fires of battle.
tenseicraft.item.first_sword.lore_3: Bestows courage upon those who overcome their first trial.

tenseicraft.abyss.descended: ✦ You have descended into the Infinite Abyss. Venture deeper into the caves to face higher-ranked foes.

tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.title: ✦ Awakened Spiritual Blade
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.style_desc.f: Consecutive hits stack Frenzy (+8% damage & speed per stack, max 5).
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.style_desc.d: +15% base damage and +40% counter-attack damage after blocking or parrying.
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.style_desc.b: Blocks 80% frontal damage and deploys a Mana Barrier when hit below 45% HP.
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.style_desc.p: Projects a vacuum wave extending your slash reach to 4.8 blocks.
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.element_desc: Pure spiritual energy without elemental alteration.
Ignites targets (5s) and detonates solar embers.
Chains lightning to up to 3 nearby enemies and slows targets.
Freezes and heavily slows targets with crystalline frost.
Drains 12% health on hit and shrouds foes in abyssal darkness.
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.resonance_de: Channels your Spirit into every slash and restores Mana in combat.
Turns your vitality into heavy strikes that shatter enemy posture.
Sharpens lethal precision, boosting critical strike chance and damage.
Each strike can trigger a Jackpot of bonus damage, Mana, and XP.
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.release_desc: [Sneak + Right-Click] Fires a piercing elemental crescent wave up to 9m.
[Sneak + Right-Click] Unleashes a 6m vortex that pulls and damages foes.
[Sneak + Right-Click] Instant shadow-step behind your target for a critical strike.
[Sneak + Right-Click] Doubles Resonance and Element effects for 12s.
[Sneak + Right-Click] Tears open a dimensional rift that suspends and slashes enemies.
[Sneak + Right-Click] Unleashes a cone of thousands of spiritual blades that shreds defenses.
[Sneak + Right-Click] Crushes enemies to the ground with overwhelming spiritual gravity.
[Sneak + Right-Click] Fires a dense piercing ray of spirit energy 25m forward.
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.mana_repair_: ♾ Unbreakable Blade: Self-repairs using your Mana (2 MP = +2 Durability)
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.exhausted: Your Spiritual Blade is exhausted! Recover Mana to regenerate its edge.
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.no_mana: Not enough Mana to unleash your First Release! (Requires %s MP)
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.lore_1: «A living blade forged and awakened from
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.lore_2: the true name bestowed by its wielder.»
tenseicraft.spiritual_sword.passive: ★ Spiritual Resonance: +0.35 Bonus Damage per Spirit point

Respected and welcomed in civilized settlements. Reduced prices.

tenseicraft.reputation.refusal_public_en: The villager flees in terror and refuses to trade with a Public Enemy!
tenseicraft.reputation.reason.raid_victo: Hero of the Village: Raid repelled
tenseicraft.worker.hire_tooltip: Hire this townswoman as a base worker.
tenseicraft.worker.arrive_base_tooltip: Confirm arrival at base to receive the Overseer's Cane.
tenseicraft.worker.edit_work_tooltip: Receive the Overseer's Cane to reconfigure work zone or chests.
tenseicraft.worker.inventory_tooltip: Inspect worker's tool and gathered items.

spell.tenseicraft.connect_realities.desc: Unleashes an abyssal shockwave that repels foes and ignites Crying Obsidian frames to awaken the Abyss Portal.
spell.tenseicraft.summon_lesser_soul: Spiritual Technique Nº 7: Summon Lesser Soul
spell.tenseicraft.summon_lesser_soul.des: Permanently manifests your loyal spiritual companion (Pelotita). Faithfully follows you, heals party members, and grows stronger with your Spirit.
effect.tenseicraft.abyssal_ward.descript: Grants complete immunity against the dimensional repulsion and void rejection of the Abyss.
spell.tenseicraft.oppressive_aura.desc: Unleashes an imposing cylindrical column of spiritual pressure expanding outwards. All trapped creatures suffer the crushing gravity of your soul.
spell.tenseicraft.spiritual_beam.desc: Universal Spiritual Sword technique. Unleashes a continuous Kamehameha-style beam capable of clashing with others in an epic Beam Clash.
spell.tenseicraft.spiritual_resonance.de: Universal supreme form of the Spiritual Sword. Unleashes a transcendent state for 30 seconds, doubling all stats, exalting the Ki aura, and playing a cinematic transformation.
spell.tenseicraft.senbonzakura_chire.des: «Scatter... Senbonzakura». The blade dissolves into thousands of microscopic petal-like blades, sweeping through all enemies in a broad frontal cone.
spell.tenseicraft.senbonzakura_vortex.de: «Petal Vortex». Unleashes a 360° spherical storm of razor petal blades around the user, drawing in and lacerating all foes in the area.
ui.tenseicraft.spiritual_beam.info2: Capable of clashing in Beam Clashes
ui.tenseicraft.power_control.title: Power Control & Regulation
item.tenseicraft.lesser_soul_crystal.des: The crystallization of the purest and most fragile soul essence. Fundamental base for human metallurgy, forging alloys, and quenching.
item.tenseicraft.resonant_soul_crystal.d: A pulsating prism charged with vital resonance. Capable of transmitting and magnifying mechanical strain in military-grade armaments.
item.tenseicraft.radiant_soul_crystal.de: A dazzling gem condensed under immense spiritual pressure. Empowers guild blacksmiths to forge edges that shear through magical barriers.
item.tenseicraft.primordial_soul_crystal: The timeless vestige of a cataclysmic soul. The supreme core for crafting legendary armaments capable of defying spiritual gods.
item.tenseicraft.life_seeds.desc1: ★ Vital essence condensed by a Guardian Spirit.
item.tenseicraft.life_seeds.desc2: Plant on farmland to grow the Flower of Life (accelerated with bone meal).
item.tenseicraft.rainbow_petals.desc1: ✦ Harvested from a fully bloomed Flower of Life.
item.tenseicraft.rainbow_petals.desc2: Alchemical catalyst to brew Prismatic Potions in a Brewing Stand.
item.tenseicraft.rpg_experience_bottle.d: ★ Grants RPG XP equal to defeating a creature one threat rank above your own.
Scales universally from Rank F all the way to Rank A → Hazard.
Returns an empty glass bottle when consumed.
item.tenseicraft.prismatic_potion.desc1: ✦ No direct effect — prismatic alchemy base.
item.tenseicraft.prismatic_potion.desc2: Brew with ingredients in a Brewing Stand (Strength, Swiftness, Healing, or RPG XP).
item.tenseicraft.prismatic_potion.effect: ❤ Prismatic Healing: Restores %s%% of your Max Health
item.tenseicraft.prismatic_potion.bottle: Reverts to a regular empty glass bottle after consumption.
effect.tenseicraft.prismatic_strength.de: Multiplicatively boosts your total accumulated attack damage.
effect.tenseicraft.prismatic_swiftness.d: Multiplicatively boosts your total movement speed.
block.tenseicraft.magic_anvil.desc1: ✦ Arcane forging relic acquired from Megu the Artisan.
block.tenseicraft.magic_anvil.desc2: Channels Soul Crystals to reforge equipment beyond mortal limits.
tenseicraft.magic_anvil.interact_hint: §d✦ [Magic Anvil] §eThe anvil's runes resonate with your soul... §7(Reforge system ready to configure)
spell.tenseicraft.hakurei.desc: Unique spiritual technique bestowed by Reimu Hakurei. Fires a Hakurei Shrine Energy Orb that bounces up to 5 times between distinct enemies.
